# Open Source Games

> A curated, community-maintained list of open-source games across browser, desktop and mobile platforms. Any genre, any platform, any engine.

## Key facts
- Catalog: open-source games organized into Browser-Based, Desktop and Mobile sections.
- Categories include arcade, FPS, RPG, MMORPG, strategy, racing, sandbox, puzzle/card/board, clicker, programming and more.
- Each entry links to source code; many include a playable demo.
- Contributions: open an issue or send a pull request on the upstream repository.
- License: MIT.
- Upstream repository: https://github.com/201flaviosilva/Open-Source-Games
- Live page: https://vip-4.github.io/Open-Source-Games/

## Documentation
- Home: https://vip-4.github.io/Open-Source-Games/
- FAQ: https://vip-4.github.io/Open-Source-Games/#faq
- Machine-readable summary: https://vip-4.github.io/Open-Source-Games/llms.txt
